segments.title: The order requests, composables, form, layout and routes
context: The back office had no place to see or change an order. This change adds three pages: a list of every order, a form that creates an order and a form that edits one. The header of every page gets a link to the list. Both forms let a staff member pick a customer and a product from the lists the back office already loads, and type a quantity. After a save, the app opens the list again, and the list requests the orders again.
## Overview
- **When** a staff member opens any page, **then** [the header shows an "Orders" link](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#L15) between "Products" and "Help".
- **When** a staff member opens `/orders`, **then** [the page shows "Loading the orders…"](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L9) until the `GET` request to `/api/orders` answers.
- **When** that request answers, **then** [the page shows one row per order with its id, its quantity, its status and an "Edit" link](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L16-21).
- **When** that request fails, **then** [the page shows "The orders could not be loaded."](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L10).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Create order", **then** [the app opens `/orders/new`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13) with [a form whose quantity is 1](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7).

- **When** a staff member submits the create form, **then** [the app sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the customer, the product, the quantity and the status `"pending"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).

- **When** that `POST` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Edit" on a row, **then** [the app opens `/orders/<id>/edit`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L20) and [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<id>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6).
- **When** that order is loaded, **then** [the form shows its customer, its product and its quantity](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).
- **When** a staff member submits the edit form, **then** [the app sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<id>` with every field of the order](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

- **When** that `PUT` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26).
- **When** a save request is running, **then** [the submit button of the form is disabled](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29).
- **When** a staff member opens the customers, the products or the help page, **then** nothing changes below the header.
## Implementation
**`src/api/orders.ts`**
- Added [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders), a function that [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4).
- Added [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder), a function that [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<orderId>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6).
- Added [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder), a function that [sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the draft as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).
- Added [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder), a function that [sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<order.id>` with the order as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).
**`src/composables/use-orders.ts`**
- Added [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#ORDERS_QUERY_KEY), the query key `["orders"]`.
- Added [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrders), a composable that [queries every order with `fetchOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7).

- Added [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrder), a composable that [queries one order under the key `["orders", orderId]` with `fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11).

- Added [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder), a composable that [returns a mutation that calls `createOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L16-17) and [invalidates every query under `["orders"]` when it succeeds](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18).

- Added [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder), a composable that [returns a mutation that calls `updateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L24-25) and [invalidates every query under `["orders"]` when it succeeds](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26).
**`src/router.ts`**
- Added [the imports of `CreateOrderPage`, `EditOrderPage` and `ViewOrdersPage`](code:src/router.ts#L4-6).

- Modified [`router`](code:src/router.ts#router) to render [`ViewOrdersPage` at `orders`](code:src/router.ts#L19), [`CreateOrderPage` at `orders/new`](code:src/router.ts#L20) and [`EditOrderPage` at `orders/:orderId/edit`](code:src/router.ts#L21), in the `children` of the `/` route.
**`src/types/order.ts`**
- Added [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), a type that is `"pending"` or `"shipped"`.
- Added [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order), an interface with `id`, `customerId`, `productId`, `quantity` and `status`.
- Added [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft), the type `Order` without `id`.
**`src/views/RootLayout.vue`**
- Modified [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#RootLayout) to [render a `<RouterLink>` to `/orders`](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#L15) between the "Products" and "Help" links.
**`src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue`**

- Added [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#OrderForm), a component that [takes `initialDraft`, `submitLabel` and `isSaving` and emits `submit`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L8-9), [copies `initialDraft` into a reactive draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L11), binds [a select of the customers](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L22-24), [a select of the products](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L25-27) and [a number input for the quantity](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L28) to the draft, and [emits `submit` with a copy of the draft when the form is submitted](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L15-17).
**`src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue`**

- Added [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#CreateOrderPage), a page that [renders `<OrderForm />` with `EMPTY_DRAFT`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20), a draft with `customerId` and `productId` set to `""`, `quantity` set to `1` and `status` set to `"pending"`, and on `submit` [calls the mutation of `useCreateOrder()` and opens `/orders` when it succeeds](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13).
**`src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue`**

- Added [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage), a page that [reads `orderId` from the route](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9), [loads the order with `useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10), [renders `<OrderForm />` with that order](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) and on `submit` [calls the mutation of `useUpdateOrder()` with the draft and `id: orderId`, and opens `/orders` when it succeeds](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14).
**`src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue`**

- Added [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#ViewOrdersPage), a page that [loads the orders with `useOrders()`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L5), renders [a "Create order" link to `/orders/new`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13) and [one row per order with an "Edit" link to `/orders/<id>/edit`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L16-21).

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrders()` to request every order

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrder()` to request one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrder()` that sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<orderId>` and returns the parsed body as an `Order`. [`useOrder()` calls it in its query function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11), so that [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage) fills the form with the order of the route.

waypoints.title: Added `createOrder()` to send a new order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `createOrder()` that sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the draft as its JSON body, and returns the order the server answers with. [`useCreateOrder()` uses it as its mutation function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L17), so that a submit of [the create order page](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L12-14) sends the draft to the server. [`request()` sets the `Content-Type` header to `application/json`](code:src/api/client.ts#L12).

waypoints.title: Added `updateOrder()` to send an edited order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `updateOrder()` that sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<order.id>` with the whole order as its JSON body, `id` included, and returns the order the server answers with. [`useUpdateOrder()` uses it as its mutation function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L25). [`<EditOrderPage />` builds the order from the draft and the `orderId` of the route](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), so that the path and the body name the same order.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the one request that changes an order the server already has. The `PUT` sends every field of the order to `/api/orders/<id>`, so `status`, which no field of [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#OrderForm) shows, is sent back as it was loaded.

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the query composables and the order requests
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name `useMutation`, `useQuery` and `useQueryClient` from `@tanstack/vue-query`, and [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder), [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder), [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) and [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder) from `@/api/orders`. [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrders) and the three composables after it hand each request to a query or a mutation.

waypoints.title: Added the query key `ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `ORDERS_QUERY_KEY` that is `["orders"]`. [`useOrders()` uses it as its key](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7), and [`useOrder()` puts the order id after it](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11). [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18) and [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26) invalidate every query whose key starts with it, so that after a save the list and every cached order are requested again the next time a page reads them.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrders()` to query every order
waypoints.reading: The author added a composable `useOrders()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders"]` and [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) as its query function. [`<ViewOrdersPage />` calls it](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L5), so that the list page renders the orders the `GET` request returns. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `staleTime` to 30 000 ms, so the list reuses a result younger than 30 seconds unless a save invalidated it.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrder()` to query one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a composable `useOrder()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", orderId]` and a query function that calls [`fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder). waypoints.reading:

waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderForm />` that:

- copies `initialDraft` into a reactive draft
- binds a select of the customers of [`useCustomers()`](code:src/composables/use-customers.ts#L6-8) to `draft.customerId`, and a select of the products of [`useProducts()`](code:src/composables/use-products.ts#L6-8) to `draft.productId`

segments.title: The create order page
context: The back office had no place to see or change an order. This change adds three pages: a list of every order, a form that creates an order and a form that edits one. The header of every page gets a link to the list. Both forms let a staff member pick a customer and a product from the lists the back office already loads, and type a quantity. After a save, the app opens the list again, and the list requests the orders again.
## Overview
- **When** a staff member opens any page, **then** [the header shows an "Orders" link](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#L15) between "Products" and "Help".
- **When** a staff member opens `/orders`, **then** [the page shows "Loading the orders…"](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L9) until the `GET` request to `/api/orders` answers.
- **When** that request answers, **then** [the page shows one row per order with its id, its quantity, its status and an "Edit" link](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L16-21).
- **When** that request fails, **then** [the page shows "The orders could not be loaded."](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L10).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Create order", **then** [the app opens `/orders/new`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13) with [a form whose quantity is 1](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7).

- **When** a staff member submits the create form, **then** [the app sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the customer, the product, the quantity and the status `"pending"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).

- **When** that `POST` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Edit" on a row, **then** [the app opens `/orders/<id>/edit`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L20) and [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<id>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6).
- **When** that order is loaded, **then** [the form shows its customer, its product and its quantity](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).
- **When** a staff member submits the edit form, **then** [the app sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<id>` with every field of the order](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

- **When** that `PUT` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26).
- **When** a save request is running, **then** [the submit button of the form is disabled](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29).
- **When** a staff member opens the customers, the products or the help page, **then** nothing changes below the header.

- Added [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder), a function that [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<orderId>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6).
- Added [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder), a function that [sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the draft as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).
- Added [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder), a function that [sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<order.id>` with the order as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).
**`src/composables/use-orders.ts`**
- Added [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#ORDERS_QUERY_KEY), the query key `["orders"]`.
- Added [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrders), a composable that [queries every order with `fetchOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7).

- Added [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrder), a composable that [queries one order under the key `["orders", orderId]` with `fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11).

**`src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue`**

- Added [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage), a page that [reads `orderId` from the route](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9), [loads the order with `useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10), [renders `<OrderForm />` with that order](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) and on `submit` [calls the mutation of `useUpdateOrder()` with the draft and `id: orderId`, and opens `/orders` when it succeeds](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14).
**`src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue`**

- Added [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#ViewOrdersPage), a page that [loads the orders with `useOrders()`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L5), renders [a "Create order" link to `/orders/new`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13) and [one row per order with an "Edit" link to `/orders/<id>/edit`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L16-21).

segments.title: The orders list page
context: The back office had no place to see or change an order. This change adds three pages: a list of every order, a form that creates an order and a form that edits one. The header of every page gets a link to the list. Both forms let a staff member pick a customer and a product from the lists the back office already loads, and type a quantity. After a save, the app opens the list again, and the list requests the orders again.
## Overview
- **When** a staff member opens any page, **then** [the header shows an "Orders" link](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#L15) between "Products" and "Help".
- **When** a staff member opens `/orders`, **then** [the page shows "Loading the orders…"](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L9) until the `GET` request to `/api/orders` answers.
- **When** that request answers, **then** [the page shows one row per order with its id, its quantity, its status and an "Edit" link](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L16-21).
- **When** that request fails, **then** [the page shows "The orders could not be loaded."](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L10).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Create order", **then** [the app opens `/orders/new`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13) with [a form whose quantity is 1](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7).

- **When** a staff member submits the create form, **then** [the app sends a `POST` request to `/api/orders` with the customer, the product, the quantity and the status `"pending"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).

- **When** that `POST` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18).

- **When** a staff member clicks "Edit" on a row, **then** [the app opens `/orders/<id>/edit`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L20) and [sends a `GET` request to `/api/orders/<id>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6).
- **When** that order is loaded, **then** [the form shows its customer, its product and its quantity](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).
- **When** a staff member submits the edit form, **then** [the app sends a `PUT` request to `/api/orders/<id>` with every field of the order](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

- **When** that `PUT` request succeeds, **then** [the app opens `/orders`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), and [the list requests the orders again](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26).
- **When** a save request is running, **then** [the submit button of the form is disabled](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29).
- **When** a staff member opens the customers, the products or the help page, **then** nothing changes below the header.

children.title: Added the error message of the orders page
children.reading:
The author added a `

` that renders "The orders could not be loaded." when `isError` is `true`. [`request()` throws an `ApiError` when the response is not ok](code:src/api/client.ts#L14), and `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `retry` to `false`, so one failed `GET` request to `/api/orders` shows this message.

children.title: Added the list of orders with its links
children.reading: The author added a `<section>` with a "Create order" link to `/orders/new` and one `<tr>` per order, with `order.id`, `order.quantity`, `order.status` and a link to `/orders/<order.id>/edit`. [The `orders/:orderId/edit` route](code:src/router.ts#L21) renders [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage) for that link, so that each row opens the edit form of its order. The row does not show the customer or the product.
